name: openkrill
description: Agent Tools by OpenKrill: public MCP servers with skills, one plugin per tool family. No API key.

plugins.name: dev-security
plugins.description: Package health, CVE triage, software end-of-life and licence facts, DESIGN.md lint and diff, and AI coding agent news.

plugins.name: web-email
plugins.description: Audit a site's SEO and AI crawler access, read a web page as clean Markdown, check a domain's mail delivery, see if a name's domain is free, and report email engagement.

plugins.name: commerce
plugins.description: Store price tracking, catalog and feed checks, HS codes, duty and landed cost, US product-safety certificates, and competitor ad angles.

plugins.name: office
plugins.description: Business days and holidays, US tax figures, EU VAT and company registries, document files, ready-to-send links, weekly lane plans and an AI-native team scorecard.

plugins.name: sales-hiring
plugins.description: Buyer signals, an inbound pitch scoreboard, open jobs at named companies, remote jobs by country, and a hire-or-automate split.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Find papers, check references and DOIs, read US federal regulations, compare country statistics, and make a school digest.

plugins.name: markets
plugins.description: Technical indicators over a price series, candlestick charts for a ticker, liquidity pool fee and volume checks, and token red-flag screens.

plugins.name: consumer
plugins.description: US recalls, car reports by VIN, food facts by barcode, and travel advice with live airport status.

plugins.name: content-media
plugins.description: Trending topics and post ideas, post and video script drafts, AI-writing checks, transcripts, free video, Live Photos, design taste, public views and likes of posts, plus YouTube transcripts, app reviews and X posts.
